vsa.headline: upthrust 29 Sep (high, downtrend); 1 Oct effort to fall - moderate significance in a downtrend; Weakness 24
vsa.narrative: Context now: downtrend (below the 50-day, -8% in 20 bars); background: upthrust 29 Sep; price at new 20-bar lows; three tests 11 Aug–24 Sep on volume 42% below average - a low-volume test inside the range (moderate significance); three no-supply bars 24 Aug–9 Sep on volume 35% below average - no selling pressure in the range (moderate significance); two no-demand bars 27 Aug–3 Sep on volume 29% below average - but no demand in the range: no professional interest in higher prices yet, followed by an upthrust 8 Sep (Holmes p.81) (low significance); effort to rise 4 Sep on 1.7x volume, closed in the upper half - effort to rise out of the range (low significance: marginal bar); upthrust 29 Sep on 1.6x volume, closed on the low - an upthrust in a downtrend - the highest-probability weakness (high significance); effort to fall 29 Sep on 1.6x volume, closed on the low - effort to fall in a downtrend: supply in control (moderate significance); last 5 bars: down bars on heavier volume (1.7x vs 1.0x) = supply in control; latest: squat bar (high volume, narrow spread) 30 Sep on 2.3x volume, closed on the low - but heavy volume, no progress inside the range (low significance); latest: effort to fall 1 Oct on 1.9x volume, closed on the low - effort to fall in a downtrend: supply in control (moderate significance); balance weakness 24/100.

rows.ref: Holmes, VSA Trade Set-Up Sequences p.18; glossary SOS 137/83 p.110, p.139; SOS 134/81/86 p.112, p.141, p.136; SOS 147 p.106

vsa_seq.lens: Williams lens (a tribute to Tom Williams's method): Background first: CBRS is in a downtrend, the VSA balance reads weakness (24/100), last key bar ETF on 1 Oct. Holmes strength sequence S9 (potential selling climax → no supply / test → demand overcoming supply) completed 8 Oct: potential climactic action / selling climax 2 Oct → no supply / test 7 Oct → demand overcoming supply 8 Oct. It confirms on a trade above 172.87; a close below 161.35 proves it wrong (armed, waiting for the trigger). Desk backtest for S9: noise (+0.02R over 734 trades).

biz.name: Cerebras Systems Inc. Class A Common Stock
biz.desc: Cerebras Systems Inc is an AI company. It designs the world's fastest AI infrastructure for training and inference. The company builds the world's largest semiconductor as well as the AI systems to power, cool, and feed the processors data. It develops software to link these systems together into industry-leading supercomputers that are simple to use even for the most complicated AI work, using familiar ML frameworks like PyTorch. Customers use its supercomputers to train industry-leading models. The company uses these supercomputers to run inference at speeds unobtainable from alternative commercial technologies. It delivers these AI capabilities to its customers on-premise and via the cloud. The company generates the majority of its revenue from the USA.
